assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium, richly art-directed finished town-screen PANORAMA for a serious science-fiction strategy game, 1792x1024 landscape. The reference is the game's approved EARTH CITY: match its painterly realism, intricate environmental storytelling, monumental architecture, beautiful strong composition and very high visual quality. Translate that artistic ambition into a human colony ON TETHYS, a cold airless icy moon of Saturn. This is a SINGLE COHERENT PAINTING of an inhabited working city, NOT a sheet of independent sprites.
Camera elevated across the city, strong layered perspective: large architectural foreground, integrated middle city, distant small infrastructure and far ice mountains. All buildable buildings stand on one broad LEVEL engineered surface, not separate cliff terraces. Dense believable civic and industrial fabric occupies almost the whole image. Thin distant icy ridges and a narrow black sky occupy upper 18 percent, small majestic Saturn upper right, its near-edge-on rings aligned exactly with the latitude bands. Restrained blue-white ice, luminous ivory and dark navy architecture, brass/copper engineering highlights, warm interior light, rich material detail, strong sunlight from upper left, coherent long shadows grounded in the same surface.
Compose 11 clearly distinct memorable facilities organically as districts, each embedded into a designed foundation and service infrastructure: a commanding tall elegant central headquarters with a strong vertical silhouette and sealed blue-gold observation windows; a jewel-like large sealed faceted science dome in lower middle-left; a beautiful sealed residential concourse and officers habitat in left foreground; a long vaulted glazed logistics exchange in lower middle-right with visible warm interior behind hermetic glass; a compact armored defense complex at rear left; six distinct enclosed shipbuilding facilities growing from small fighter bays at mid left, gunship workshop lower left, corvette plant right middle, tall ribbed frigate assembly hall rear right, substantial destroyer works far right, monumental cruiser assembly building in right foreground. Make every facility architecturally unique, NOT repeated identical grey barrel hangars. All hangar doors and inhabited areas must be hermetically sealed. Closed pressure walkways, buried utility channels with access covers, low protective retaining kerbs, service lanes, piping, reactor auxiliaries, radiator arrays, loading equipment and very small robotic vehicles organically CONNECT the city and visually fill the spaces. These shared permanent features must make the whole base feel like one place.
Foreground framed by a few dark icy rocks, thick utility structures and a close architectural edge; distant mountains only beyond the level city. No evenly spaced objects on bare grey dirt. No flat grid presentation. No empty expanses separating tiny buildings. No white plastic toy models, no generic mobile game factory catalogue. Match the reference's depth, richness, visual hierarchy, grandeur and fine finish. No Earth plants, trees, water, waterfalls, medieval churches, exposed public plazas or unprotected people. No clouds or atmospheric haze on Tethys. No labels, text, UI, borders. Build a beautiful complex designed human city, grounded engineering with a distinctive aspirational ivory/navy/brass identity.

assets.prompt: Edit the reference finished moon city panorama with ONLY these fixes. Preserve exact composition, camera, architecture, all facility positions, surface, rich detail, lighting and colors. Seal every currently open hangar front with credible closed blue-grey segmented pressure gates; narrow reinforced glass strips may show warm light inside. Keep spacecraft behind those sealed gates, not protruding into outdoors. The large glazed logistics hall at lower middle-right must have a closed transparent armored GLASS front wall with visible pressure-frame ribs, not an open arch. The round residential complexes lower left must have sealed glass canopy roofs rather than open courtyards. Every occupied area is airtight in vacuum. Preserve all service lanes and closed connecting tunnels. Fix Saturn in upper right: much smaller, full sphere fully inside the sky with a clear margin above and below; its entire near-edge-on ring system also fits inside the image without cropping and is parallel to latitude bands. No UI, labels or new buildings. Keep this beautiful cohesive city intact, change only the air seals and the Saturn framing.
